title: Repair throughput line chart (line-struck, malformed, and clipped text)
what: v2.0 peak throughput (req/s), its gain over v1.0 at c=64 (%), or v1.1 regression at c=128 (%)
required_disclosures: no %% typo or ASCII hyphen minus

reader_questions.question: Where does v2.0 peak and how much faster is it than v1.0 there?
reader_questions.expected: v2.0 peaks at 4,820 req/s at concurrency 64 (+47.9% over v1.0's 3,260 req/s).

reader_questions.question: Are these single benchmark sweeps per concurrency level?
reader_questions.expected: Yes, one throughput measurement per (release, concurrency) point.

reader_questions.question: What happens to v1.1 and v2.0 at concurrency 128?
reader_questions.expected: Both drop past concurrency 64; v1.1 falls to 2,520 req/s (-19.2% below v1.0).
